about_the_game:
Step into the underground world of caves in the most realistic VR spelunking game, where the entire environment is your map, just waiting to be discovered.

🏋️‍♀️Beat environmental challenges: steep climbs, narrow tunnels and ice cold water

🚩Mark your own clues on cave walls with chalk

🔨Clear your path of obstacles with a hammer

⛏️Climb walls and ceilings using ice axes

👨‍🔧Maintain your gear to ensure its reliability

👀 No cheap horror tricks – just a mysterious and immersive cave atmosphere

🕹️ Multiple gameplay modes: Story, Horror and Adventure

Story Mode

Follow the story of Jake, who is retracing the footsteps of his father — a famous spelunker — and uncover family secrets as he descends deeper into the abyss of the caves. There are no cheap jump scares or artificial anxiety-inducing mechanics included - the main game fear factors are headlamp battery life and well… players’ nerves!

Horror Mode

A standalone, completely optional mode that introduces survival-horror elements. Players navigate unfamiliar sections of the cave with limited tools while facing potential threats. Intended for users seeking a tense and frightening experience, this mode unlocks after completing the first chapter of the Story Mode. The HORROR mode is completely optional and not connected to the story campaign in any way (players may skip it entirely).

Tourist Mode

A relaxed mode for revisiting previously explored caves without gameplay pressure. Designed for players who want to immerse themselves in the visuals and atmospheric soundtrack at their own pace.

Gameplay Features

  • Realistic Cave Layouts Irregular, natural cave structures that avoid repetition or tiled environments.

  • Detailed Environmental Interaction Players can move rocks, observe dripping water, and interact with reactive surroundings.

  • No Built-in Map System Players must mark trails with chalk, promoting true exploration and self-reliance.

  • Free Climbing Mechanics Climb any surface, choosing your own routes—no predefined climbing paths.

  • Breath Management System Manage your breathing in tight passages. Underwater cave diving, tied to this system, arrives in the upcoming free updates.

Obstacle Interaction Use tools to break stalactites, remove debris, and clear blockages in the cave system.

name: Cave Crave VR

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX1060 / AMD Radeon RX580
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, Meta Quest or PlayStation VR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX3060 / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, Meta Quest or PlayStation VR

short_description: Step into the underground world of caves in the most realistic VR spelunking game, where the entire environment is your map, just waiting to be discovered! Steep climbs, narrow tunnels and water await! Play the Story Mode, have fun in Tourist Mode or get scared in an optional Horror Mode!
